mechanism_claims.claim_text: Deca-(Arg)8 inhibits late hepadnavirus morphogenesis by blocking enveloped virion and subviral-particle formation/release while naked nucleocapsid egress remains detectable.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Deca-(Arg)8 cationic lipopeptide in DHBV-infected PDH and DHBV-transfected LMH-D2 systems
mechanism_claims.limitations: The paper supports the late morphogenesis/secretion block; it does not prove a single molecular binding target for Deca-(Arg)8.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Deca-(Arg)8 does not measurably reduce DHBV entry/infectivity, cccDNA formation, viral mRNA synthesis, viral protein expression, or mature intracellular nucleocapsid formation under the tested conditions.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Deca-(Arg)8 in PDH and LMH-D2 DHBV models
